claim_boundary: Read-only replay of frozen FD-1 frames through the current-frame crop/invert adapter and TTC estimator; no neural chart run, game, score, or training.
engineering_assumption: Raw FD-1 normalized_position is (strike_line_y - head_y)/playfield_height: 0 at strike line, 1 at top. Crop heads outside [0,1], transform valid heads to progress=1-raw_position, and infer hold identity only from a same-lane co-visible tail. Clamp a tail at/past strike line to zero.

progress increases as same selected head approaches
TTC output is finite and in [0,1]
no chart labels or schedule enter encoder
